# Bio

My name is Laith Saeed.I am originally from Jordan and a chemical engineering graduate from the University of Ottawa's class of 2018.

A majority of my experience has been in account and project management in the FinTech sector. I am attending the MDS V program in order to help me land a technical role (Data Scientist , ML Engineer, AI Researcher etc.)
